name: EmailOctopus
description_en:
EmailOctopus is an email-focused marketing service for creating campaigns, collecting subscribers and automating follow-ups. Lists contain subscriber fields and tags that can be used for targeting and personalization. Its standard product handles email marketing; the separate Connect offer uses an Amazon SES connection and has different delivery-cost responsibilities.

A new subscriber, an existing subscriber receiving a tag and a changed field value are different automation events. This profile explains their entry and lifecycle behavior, Starter limits and migration considerations. It does not report live sending tests or measured savings.
description_zh:
EmailOctopus 是专注邮件的营销服务，用于制作活动、收集订阅者和自动跟进。名单中的字段和标签可用于筛选与个性化。标准产品提供邮件营销，独立的 Connect 方案连接 Amazon SES，其投递费用责任不同。

新增订阅者、给现有人添加标签和修改字段值，是不同自动化事件。本文解释进入与生命周期行为、Starter 限制和迁移事项，不提供实际发信测试或节省费用的测量结果。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.

sections.title_en: Begin with a maintained email audience
sections.title_zh: 从维护好的邮件受众开始
sections.en:
EmailOctopus describes campaigns, forms, subscriber fields, tags and segmentation, and explicitly says the product does not provide SMS. For an illustrative reader onboarding, collect a subscription and reading interest, then send the appropriate email sequence.

Treat a field as data, a tag as a label and a trigger as an event. Keeping these roles clear makes it easier to inspect why a person received a message. This is an editorial design suggestion; no reader journey was executed.
sections.zh:
EmailOctopus 介绍活动、表单、订阅字段、标签和分组，并明确产品不提供短信。例如读者入门，可收集订阅和阅读兴趣，再发送适合的邮件序列。

把字段作为数据、标签作为标记、触发器作为事件，有助检查某人为何收到邮件。这是编辑设计建议，本文未执行读者沟通路径。

sections.title_en: Activate before applying the enrollment tag
sections.title_zh: 先启用，再添加进入标签
sections.en:
The Contact added trigger works only for contacts joining after activation. Enabling imported contacts does not retroactively enroll everyone already on the list. The official existing-contact guide instead uses Contact tag added and applies the tag after starting the automation.

For existing readers, define an enrollment tag and verify that only the intended population receives it. A Contact field updated trigger also does not fire on the field’s first assignment, such as initial signup. Test the exact event transition rather than only the final visible field value.
sections.zh:
Contact added 仅对启用后加入的人生效，允许导入联系人也不会追溯让现有整名单进入。现有人指南采用 Contact tag added，并要求启用后再添加标签。

对已有读者，应明确进入标签并确认只有目标人群获得它。Contact field updated 也不会在字段首次赋值时触发，例如初次订阅。应测试事件变化本身，不能只看最终字段值。

sections.en:
The troubleshooting guide says pausing keeps contacts frozen while steps can be edited. Stop prevents new entry and immediately exits contacts already inside; it is irreversible. It also says people who completed a sequence do not automatically traverse later appended steps.

For a course correction, decide whether learners should wait, exit, or receive a separate one-off update. Do not append a correction and assume graduates will receive it. Investigate missing messages by checking activation, list, entry time and filters before restarting or retagging an audience.
sections.zh:
排错指南说明暂停时联系人保持冻结，可以编辑步骤；停止则阻止进入并立即让现有人退出，且不可撤销。已完成序列的人也不会自动经过后来添加的步骤。

课程修正时，应决定学员等待、退出，还是另收一次单独更新。不能追加修正就假定已毕业的人会收到。邮件缺失时，建议先检查启用、名单、进入时间和筛选，再考虑重启或重新添加标签。

sections.title_en: A free plan still has workflow and reporting limits
sections.title_zh: 免费版仍有流程与报表限制
sections.en:
Starter is an ongoing free plan rather than a timed trial. The official guide lists 2,500 contacts, 10,000 monthly emails, one user, three automations with at most five steps each excluding the trigger, and ten fields and ten tags per list. Reports are accessible for 30 days; branding remains and only one form and landing page are included.

A five-step allowance is used by more than email count: waits, conditions and actions also occupy the design. Draw the intended short onboarding before deciding it fits. More steps or longer historical reporting require checking Pro entitlements.
sections.zh:
Starter 是持续免费套餐，不是限时试用。官方指南列出 2,500 位联系人、每月 10,000 封、一个用户、三个自动化，每个最多五步且不含触发器；每个名单最多十个字段和十个标签。报表可访问 30 天，保留品牌，并只含一个表单和落地页。

五步额度不能只按邮件封数理解，等待、条件和动作也占用流程设计。判断是否适用前先画出简短入门路径；更多步骤或更长报表历史需核对 Pro 权限。

sections.title_en: Rebuild semantics, not just the visual template
sections.en:
The migration guide says to preserve needed fields and tags, recreate automations and update merge tags when importing HTML from another service. It recommends domain verification and carrying excluded people as Unsubscribed; those contacts cannot be mailed and do not count toward the subscriber limit.

For an existing newsletter, compare a migrated message using a populated name and a missing name. Review whether imported contacts should trigger a welcome sequence they already received elsewhere. Matching the old visual design alone does not preserve subscription or trigger behavior.
sections.zh:
迁移指南要求保留必要字段和标签、重建自动化，并在从其他服务导入 HTML 时更新合并标签；还建议验证域名，并将需排除的人保留为 Unsubscribed。这些人不能收到邮件，也不占订阅者额度。

迁移已有简报时，可分别检查名字有值和缺失时的邮件。应确认导入联系人是否要重新触发他们在原系统已收过的欢迎序列；外观一致不能保留订阅或触发语义。

sections.title_en: Standard and Connect have different cost boundaries
sections.title_zh: 标准版与 Connect 的成本边界不同
sections.en:
The standard pricing card rendered $9 per month billed yearly with 10,000 monthly emails; the subscriber slider was not fully exposed, so that is not a universal monthly quote. Paid plans scale and can upgrade automatically. Connect separately uses a customer Amazon SES account, whose sending charges are additional.

For standard Starter, 2,500 subscribers each receiving four newsletters would use 10,000 sends before extra communication. This hypothetical full-capacity example leaves no margin. Choose capacity from the actual audience, frequency and automation volume rather than the headline number.
sections.zh:
标准价格卡片显示每月 $9、按年付款及每月 10,000 封，但订阅者滑块未完整呈现，因此不能当通用月付报价。付费档位可随增长自动升级。Connect 则单独使用客户的 Amazon SES 账户，发送费用另计。

在标准 Starter 中，假设 2,500 位订阅者每人收到四封简报，就用完 10,000 次，额外沟通没有余量。这是假设满额算例，应按真实受众、频率和自动化量选择容量。

sections.title_en: Retained contacts do not guarantee continued sending
sections.title_zh: 保留联系人不保证能继续发送
sections.en:
The downgrade guide says contacts are retained when returning to Starter, but sending is unavailable if the list exceeds its limit. Older reports become inaccessible until upgrading again. It also states that free accounts inactive for a full year are deleted.

EmailOctopus is worth evaluating for an email-only operator with a manageable list and explicit automation needs. Plan an export and activity policy if the account is seasonal. Self-hosting rights, source license, regional offers, actual SES permissions and live recovery behavior were not verified here.
sections.zh:
降级指南说明回到 Starter 时保留联系人，但名单超额就无法发送；旧报表会变为不可访问，重新升级后恢复。指南还说明完全不活跃一年会删除免费账户。

名单可维护且自动化需求明确、只需要邮件的运营者，可评估 EmailOctopus。季节性账户应安排导出及活跃策略。本文未确认自托管权利、源码许可、地区报价、真实 SES 权限或实际恢复行为。
